data.name: Nawfan
data.gender_notes: Nawfan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-f' which means forgiveness and generosity. In Islamic history, the name Nawfan is associated with the story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) who was granted forgiveness by Allah. The name Nawfan carries the meaning “Forgiveness, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawfan usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiveness, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey towards forgiveness and generosity towards others.
data.etymology: Nawfan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiveness, Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawfan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: نوفان هو اسم مشتق من الجذر النوني والواو والفاء، ويشير إلى الزيادة والنمو في الخير والبركة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالنماء والزيادة في الحسنات والفضائل.

in_urdu.name: نوفان
in_urdu.meaning: نوفان کا مطلب ہے وادئ میں اضافہ اور نشوونما
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوفان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وادئ میں اضافہ اور نشوونما۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو وادئ کی طرح اپنے آس پاس کے لوگوں کو فائدہ پہنچاتا ہے اور ان کی زندگی میں نشوونما لاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नौफान
in_hindi.meaning: नौफान का अर्थ है अच्छाई और समृद्धि में वृद्धि

data.cultural_impact: The name Nawfan carries a rich cultural heritage, as it is derived from the Arabic language, which is the liturgical language of the Islamic faith. Arabic names, like Nawfan, often have significant meanings rooted in Islamic history, culture, and traditions. This name reflects the importance of seeking and granting forgiveness, a fundamental tenet in Islam, which is essential for maintaining healthy relationships and leading a virtuous life. This cultural impact encourages individuals named Nawfan to strive for forgiveness and generosity in their personal and communal interactions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name Nawfan lies in its association with Prophet Yunus (Jonus). His story highlights the endless mercy and benevolence of Allah, who forgives even the most extreme sins when repentance is sincere. This name serves as a reminder of the divine mercy bestowed upon humankind, emphasizing the importance of seeking forgiveness from Allah and extending forgiveness to others. Furthermore, by embracing the generosity and forgiveness inherent in this name, individuals named Nawfan can grow spiritually by developing a deep, abiding faith in Allah's mercy and integrating forgiveness into their daily lives.
